run_trainer_original: run the trainerWrapper_original function to train a body mocap model on 3DPW and H36M datasets
run_exemplar_trainer: run the exemplarTrainerWrapper function to fit EFT exemplars across the entire database
run_eft_3dpw_test: run the eft3DPWTestWrapper function to test EFT fitting on the 3DPW dataset
run_smplify_all: run the smplifyAllWrapper function to apply SMPLify optimization across the entire database
run_exemplar_analysis: run the exemplarTrainerWrapper_analysis function to analyze EFT fitting results on 3DPW and H36M datasets
